## Checklist

Check the boxes when done, and feel the "done" 🙂.

- [ ] Get ready for your repositories
    - [ ] Accept the invitation to join the GitHub-Organization [{{< var org.name >}}]({{< var org.link >}}). Check your emails for the invitation, or go to the page while logged in and find the acceptance button.
    - [ ] Make your tool ready for work with R, tidyverse, and quarto. 
        - [ ] Check that you have R 4.6.1 and the `tidyverse` package installed.
- [ ] Read the [syllabus](../index.qmd), come up with clarification question. 
- [ ] Readings done. 
- [ ] Reading comments submitted.
